Step 7: click data-testid='dec-sku-2' two more times (three clicks total on this control); then verify data-testid='qty-sku-2' is '0' (it must never become negative), data-testid='cart-count' is '3', and data-testid='cart-total' is '$109.97'. The verification passes only if every one of these exact values is observed in order.

    ``````markdown
    ## Result Format
    At the end of the test, respond with the following JSON:
    {
        "status": "pass" | "fail",
        "reason": "A detailed explanation of why the test passed or failed."
    }
    ``````
